step1_figure.circuit_type: Cascode Operational Transconductance Amplifier (OTA) with Class-AB Output Stage
step1_figure.description: The circuit combines a cascode differential OTA first stage with a push-pull/class-AB output buffer biased by floating current source transistors (MFCP and MFCN) and driving output transistors MON and MOP, stabilized via indirect feedback compensation capacitor Cc.

open_loop_dc_gain.description: Low-frequency open-loop voltage gain of the two-stage class-AB buffered OTA

equation.formula: A_OLDC = A_1 * A_2 = [gmn1 * (Rocasn || Rocasp)] * [(gmn_out + gmp_out) * (ron_out || rop_out)]
equation.explanation: The overall gain is the product of the first-stage cascode OTA gain A1 and the second-stage class-AB push-pull buffer gain A2.
equation.assumptions: Output buffer transistors MON and MOP are 1x sized (50/2 and 100/2) operating in saturation with ro = 1/(lambda*Id).

sky130_expected.calculation: For first stage: Id = 10 uA, gmn = sqrt(2 * 270u * (50/2) * 10u) = 367 uA/V. Cascode ro_casc ~ gm*ro^2 ~ 367u * (1/(0.1*10u))^2 = 367u * 1e12 = 36.7 Mohm. A1 ~ 367u * 18 Mohm ~ 6600 (~76 dB). Second stage push-pull: gmn + gmp ~ 367u + 158u = 525 uA/V, ro_out ~ 1/(0.1*10u) || 1/(0.1*10u) = 500 kohm, A2 ~ 525u * 500k = 262 (~48 dB). With loaded cascode and non-ideal early voltage in 130nm, total DC gain A_OLDC is typically 70 dB to 95 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Cascode first stage provides high output impedance and class-AB output stage provides moderate voltage gain.

unity_gain_frequency.description: Gain-bandwidth product (unity-gain frequency) of the op-amp

equation.explanation: Unity gain frequency determined by the input transconductance and indirect compensation capacitance Cc.
equation.assumptions: Cc = 240 fF, dominant pole set by Cc feedback.

sky130_expected.reasoning: High transconductance in Sky130 0.18um NMOS differential pair driving small 240 fF compensation capacitor.

phase_margin.description: Phase margin at the unity-gain crossover frequency

equation.explanation: Measures loop stability at unity gain crossover frequency.
equation.assumptions: Standard compensation with Cc = 240 fF driving 1 pF load.

sky130_expected.calculation: Indirect compensation places non-dominant pole at higher frequency than direct Miller compensation, yielding PM between 60 and 80 degrees.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Text mentions indirect compensation ensures high phase margin (~70-85 deg) for stable closed-loop operation.

slew_rate.description: Large-signal slew rate of the output voltage

equation.explanation: Maximum rate of change of output voltage during large step input transient, governed by tail current Iss charging Cc.

sky130_expected.reasoning: The differential pair tail current (20 uA total) slews the indirect compensation capacitor.

quiescent_current.description: Total quiescent current drawn from VDD including bias circuit

equation.explanation: Total supply current in DC/quiescent state, including bias generator and OTA stages.
equation.assumptions: Bias network consumes ~140 uA, op-amp core consumes ~30-50 uA.

sky130_expected.calculation: I_VDD = 140 uA (bias) + 20 uA (diff-pair branches) + 10 uA (cascode branch) + 10 uA (class-AB output branch) ~ 180 uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: As shown in Fig 24.41, current drops by ~100 uA compared to CS output buffer, sitting at ~160-180 uA total.

output_swing_high.description: High output voltage level reached during inverting step response

equation.explanation: In an inverting amplifier with Gain = -1 (R1=R2=10k) and V_CM = 0.9V, when Vin goes low (0.18V), Vout goes high.
equation.assumptions: Linear rail-to-rail push-pull output stage driving 1 pF load.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Push-pull PMOS MOP pulls output close to 1.62V in closed-loop gain of -1.

output_swing_low.description: Low output voltage level reached during inverting step response

equation.explanation: In inverting amplifier with Gain = -1 (R1=R2=10k) and V_CM = 0.9V, when Vin goes high (1.62V), Vout swings low.
equation.assumptions: Class-AB NMOS MON pulls output low.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Push-pull NMOS MON pulls output down to 0.18V in closed-loop gain of -1.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench simulating both transient step response of the class-AB buffered OTA in inverting amplifier configuration (Fig. 24.41) and open-loop AC characteristics (gain, GBW, PM).
